superseded_do_not_cite_as_law.why: v1. Used storage BPW as active BPW, accepted the 560-647 reuse band, and computed 0.135% by mixing a mixed-artifact floor with a Q4 runtime. Superseded the same day by G013_FS_EFFICIENCY_CLOSURE_V2.json.
Same category error as G013 v1.

Still publishes G013 v1 (156970 fs at 0.135%, BPW < 0.448-0.518). The CORRECTION block later in the same file is the live law.

entries.mechanism: Reach sub-100 fs/weight on this box with any existing Q80 pack
entries.what_was_expected: mixed-sub655-v1 at 0.6462 complete_physical_bpw would clear the ledger's sub-100 fs threshold (nominal BPW < 0.6552 at efficiency=1.0). G013 v1 restated the requirement as BPW < 0.448-0.518 against a 560-647 GB/s control.

what_was_measured.must_include: attention and lm_head, the dominant mass, not just experts

entries.why_it_failed: The 0.6462 figure is a storage average over 512 experts. Decode at batch=1 reads 10 of 512. Attention + lm_head stay at 4.25-8.25 BPW, so active BPW is 2.518. Even a perfect load-only kernel at the honest decode ceiling cannot put that mass under 100 fs. Unity 819 GB/s still bottoms out at 384 fs.

entries.why_it_failed: Storage BPW averages over unused experts. At batch=1 only top-10 routed experts are read; attention, lm_head, router and shared expert are read every token at their native (much higher) BPW.

entries.mechanism: Use the 535-637 GB/s reuse band (also written 560-647) as the decode ceiling
entries.what_was_expected: A no-model DRAM-row / reuse probe at 535.9-637.5 (or 560-647) GB/s is the achievable bandwidth for decode.
entries.why_it_failed: The 64 MiB working set reused 4096x is cache-resident. Decode reads each weight once per token. The honest control is unique-bytes-once in the real command-buffer topology (320-411 GB/s), not the reuse roofline and not 819.

entries.mechanism: Compress routed experts to move fs/weight or token time (the density campaign on the 9%)
entries.what_was_expected: Because routed experts are ~97% of Q80's stored mass, crushing them is the velocity lever.
entries.why_it_failed: Storage mass is not traffic. At batch=1 the unread 502 experts do not move. Crushing unused experts to zero removes 9% of per-token bytes. Attention is the only mass whose compression changes the token.

entries.mechanism: Assume lower storage BPW is faster per token (density is velocity)
entries.what_was_expected: Moving Q80 from uniform-Q4 4.259 BPW to mixed 1.4444 BPW buys bytes and therefore token time.
entries.why_it_failed: Binary / rice_q1 / low-rank need expensive per-weight reconstruction. Density bought bytes and lost more to reconstruction. On the mixed G020 vehicle Q80 is GPU-matvec-bound, not host-bound. The Q4-vehicle 'host/sync-bound' claim does not transfer.
